interpretation: Both runs stop during the first KDM6 call before any completed POST_KDM6 state. Their public pre-call QG and BG arrays match the v17 baseline bit for bit; neither has a source-defined graupel transient at entry. All five completed Q/N/B states (PRE_RK, RK1, RK2, RK3, PRE_KDM6) pass strict field, paired-moment, PSD-cone, density-conversion, and entry-cap audit checks. ProgB later rejects an unsupported state without reporting its coordinate; no FogDES reject marker is present, and cloud probe values are unchanged between STEP_BEGIN and FOGDES_INPUT.
